integrity: Exact hazard-derivative and monotonicity-polynomial identities; a standalone symbolic/numerical sanity checker reports 136 passing checks. The analytic argument, not finite numerical sampling, establishes the infinite-domain statement.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the one-parameter LR1 exponential/Gamma(4) mixture in a declared fixed time unit. The broad qualitative bathtub classification is previous mathematics. The uninspected full text of Block, Langberg and Savits (2012) remains a priority risk for generic quantitative formulas. No maintenance-cost optimum or independent audit is claimed.
title: Sharp parameter dependence of the hazard-minimum age in the LR1 lifetime model
